title: Device-local note that a Claude Code SessionStart hook did not record its session; not an authority envelope
description: Written by the dharma-agent-fabric-preview plugin's hook launcher at DHARMA_HOME/session-messages/claude-session-start-failures/<sessionId>.json and read by `dharma sessions attach --provider claude --current`. The plugin and the CLI ship separately. `pending` is written before the CLI runs, so a hook stopped at its timeout still leaves it; `failed` says why no session record followed. The CLI removes the note once the session is recorded. It holds the session id, the working directory, a time and a fixed reason code only; nothing from it is put into a command line.
